items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: the violinist, who is also a guitarist, Art Johnson, who was in Los Angeles for years, uses electric violin at times.

ctx.x: It’s primarily still acoustic, but the violinist, who is also a guitarist, Art Johnson, who was in Los Angeles for years, uses electric violin at times. But it’s primarily an acoustic group, acoustic bass and drums, but cello and bass clarinet and various interesting combinations of instruments, and we’re doing a lot more exploratory kind of improvisational music. It’s really probably closer to the classical world than jazz as such, although everyone is from the jazz world, all the players are. So I’m more and…
Do you recall a record by Roger Kellaway, the “Cello Quartet?”
